summary: Implemented the rich_measure feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative depth-first walk with explicit stack, 4-cell indent per level). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or min with width), and adds VerticalCenter (render, measurement, repr, Jupyter mixin). rich/console.py print now passes justify="default" to render options; the justify argument still goes to _collect_renderables. CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked Unreleased with an Added section. tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py gained the specified imports and tests. Tests were not run, per instructions; all verification was by reading the code. Recommended next step: run pytest on tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py, then the full suite, since the Align width constraint could affect other renderables.
